What's the process for adding the documentation for a plugin to the online manual?
It seems to be a bit of a catch-22
A developer builds a plugin, but until the documentation is somehow added to the manual, the developer does not know the url for their plugin's documentation, so cannot provide the information for the plugin's metadata.
Are we meant to clone https://github.com/opencpn-manuals, add our changes to site.yml and submit a PR ?

It's a decentralized approach basically in the hands of each plugin dev. Bits and pieces:

  1. All included plugins are listed in https://github.com/opencpn-manuals/main/blob/main/site.yml. If a new plugin should be added, please make a PR against https://github.com/opencpn-manuals/main/
  2. Plugin devs updates their sources for the manual.
  3. The manual is rebuilt regularly, at least daily. This makes the new manual visible.
  4. In order to get a usable turn around, it is important to establish a local build chain using antora. This is basically about getting antora to work , see https://docs.antora.org/antora/3.0/install/install-antora/. This way the results can be checked without having to wait for the complete manual to be rebuilt

EDIT: sorry for delayed answer

Newbie here, so please correct my transgressions. I'm trying to build demo_pi_sample on Windows without success. I get the following from cmake:

Could NOT find Gettext (missing: GETTEXT_MSGMERGE_EXECUTABLE
GETTEXT_MSGFMT_EXECUTABLE)
Call Stack (most recent call first):
C:/Program Files/CMake/share/cmake-4.4/Modules/FindPackageHandleStandardArgs.cmake:654 (_FPHSA_FAILURE_MESSAGE)
C:/Program Files/CMake/share/cmake-4.4/Modules/FindGettext.cmake:430 (find_package_handle_standard_args)
cmake/PluginConfigure.cmake:165 (FIND_PACKAGE)
CMakeLists.txt:50 (include)

I do have Gettext installed, but apparently don't have msgmerge (and don't know now to get it). I have no trouble building opencpn however, so most of the dependencies are all there.

And assuming I am eventually successful building a plugin with Visual Studio, how do I debug it?

Thanks.

Most likely you haven't added whatever the gettext bin folder to your path.
On my machine:

dir msgmerge.exe /s
Directory of C:\Program Files\Poedit\GettextTools\bin
14/09/2024  10:47 PM            75,976 msgmerge.exe

So just add C:\Program Files\Poedit\GettextTools\bin to your path environment variable.

For debugging from Visual Studio.
Three things.

  1. Set the plugin as the "Startup Project"
  2. Set the debug properties, for the startup command to be OpenCPN
  3. Then just start the debugger and it should load OpenCPN.
